```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(categories |>
              rename(category_description = description),
            by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw))

```

```{r}
crypto |>
  summarize(total_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .by = date) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_cap / 1e12)) +
  geom_line(color = "#7b2cbf", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(suffix = "T")) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Crypto Market Cap, 2018 to 2026",
    subtitle = "Sum of 22 coins' daily market caps",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Market cap (trillions of USD)",
    caption = "Source: Coin Metrics Community Data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
share_data <- crypto |>
  summarize(cat_mcap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = c(date, category_name)) |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, cat_mcap,
                                     .fun = median, .desc = TRUE))

share_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cat_mcap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
           xmax = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11")),
           ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
           fill = "black", alpha = 0.35) +
  annotate("label",
           x = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
           y = c(0.95, 0.85),
           label = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
           size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.95) +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin's Share of the Crypto Market Grew After 2022",
    subtitle = "Share of total market cap held by each category, 22 major coins, 2018 to 2026",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: Coin Metrics Community Data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
